summary: Prevent false Codex provider failures during large-session resume bursts
description: Investigate the 2026-09-04 Telegram provider-failure burst, document the incident and common Hermes failure modes, fix the contradictory large-request TTFB scaling/cap behavior, and prove focused plus live runtime behavior without enabling unreliable fallbacks.
acceptance: R1: Exact 2026-09-04 failure window, affected sessions, root cause, trigger, and update/live status are captured in a dated incident report.
R2: Hermes troubleshooting documentation contains a concise frequently-occurring-errors matrix with signatures, causes, checks, and fixes.
R3: Large Codex requests retain a finite watchdog but the default maximum no longer negates context-size scaling; explicit operator caps remain honored.
R4: Regression tests prove default scaling above 100k tokens and explicit cap behavior.
R5: Focused tests, broader relevant tests, config/doctor checks, direct provider probes, and loaded runtime evidence are recorded truthfully.
